theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible theme combining a clean trend tag (hurst 'trend'), the highest durability_bar (0.79), the highest breadth (0.80), and non-crowded status. Although it trails Banks on raw rank by a hair, its trend-health legs are materially stronger, and in a gate-true market the trend-gate leg is the only validated edge — favouring the theme with the deepest staying power rather than the top rank.
